teams.name: Genotype-matched existing drugs
teams.mandate: Match a causal human genotype to an existing article; prioritize enasidenib/D2HGA2 and a meaningful alternative.
teams.next_action: Define an obtainable pediatric article/data and organ-benefit package; compare with a differentiated contribution to the funded trametinib program.

teams.name: Local dermatology with human evidence
teams.mandate: Compare topical erlotinib/KRT16 and APR-246/AEC using controlled effects, exact product and access.
teams.next_action: Resolve exact article, independent-patient comparison and attainable product/data interest before pricing a milestone.

teams.name: Human genetics and target direction
teams.mandate: Find a distinct non-oncology opportunity supported by human causal genetics and a direction-matched drug; test reversibility and tissue exposure.
teams.next_action: Map a differentiated contribution to existing TEK clinical development, including symptoms, subgroup evidence and attainable rights.

teams.name: Clinically characterized discontinued assets
teams.mandate: Find existing Phase I/II assets with an understood discontinuation reason and defensible revised indication or population; distinguish failed efficacy from financing.
teams.next_action: Reconcile mavoglurant randomized denominators and useful effect; assess a discrete sponsor participation package. Recover STOPFOP outcomes before a new commitment.

teams.name: Rare neurometabolic function
teams.mandate: Evaluate levodopa/carbidopa in MCT8 deficiency and a mechanistically distinct alternative, with symptomatic and disease-modifying claims separated.
teams.lead: levodopa/carbidopa / symptomatic motor function in MCT8 deficiency
teams.next_action: Reconcile patient-level MCT8 motor effects and obtain a reproducible formulation/endpoint proposition; assess an unfilled contribution to existing SCA27B development.

teams.name: Ocular local delivery and repair
teams.mandate: Compare a repo ocular candidate with a human-evidence alternative; exact product, exposure and functional benefit govern.
teams.lead: exact topical-insulin product / refractory noninfectious persistent corneal epithelial defects
teams.next_action: Establish a differentiated product/data contribution to existing controlled development; verify rights, clinically meaningful endpoints and full exposure before funding experiments.

teams.name: Neuromuscular translation
teams.mandate: Compare BLU-3797/XLMTM and exact 8015-P2/MFN2-CMT2A; prioritize human-function evidence, exposure and attainable interest.
teams.next_action: Compare exact-article access, rights and human-functional feasibility packages; do not transfer 8015-mixture human evidence to P2.

teams.name: Ex vivo organ preservation
teams.mandate: Evaluate AAT/donor-lung preservation and a distinct organ-preservation alternative; connect organ function to recipient outcomes and paid process contributions.
teams.lead: AAT / exact Zemaira donor-lung preservation process
teams.next_action: Define a partner-useful exact product/activity/process milestone and recover full methods and protocol; price only after attainable interest is established.

teams.name: Precision CNS and controlled function
teams.mandate: Evaluate GA002/mesial temporal-lobe epilepsy against a more clinically characterized precision-neurology alternative; inspect complete safety, endpoints and access.
teams.next_action: Assess an identifiable contribution to the advanced program; recover complete GA002 clinical and all-treated safety reports before considering early participation.

teams.name: Early synthesis and bounded institutional options
teams.mandate: Evaluate FD-2/ALS and a distinct early-stage licensing opportunity; exact article, translation, rights and a financeable stopping point determine priority.
teams.next_action: Compare exact article identity, existing exposure/data and attainable institutional rights before synthesis; preserve preservation versus repair distinctions.
